stage: Matched-drift experiment: do post-drift scores separate malicious from benign drift, or mainly respond to novelty relative to the source regime

source_data.note: Pilot-v2 TRAIN-v2 and CAL-v2 (development seeds, unchanged) are the source regime for all detectors and the novelty reference. They are NOT final evidence.

shared_before_drift: background link condition of every container
uniform draws behind the publish microstructure (interval, size, topic) of the continuing connection
twin_design.differ_only_by: the benign-versus-malicious post-drift intervention: benign branch = frozen B1 generator, malicious branch = frozen M1/M2 (or M3) generator, with independent post-drift parameter streams; M1 attackers connect from an attacker container with the same background link condition as the identity's device container; label
twin_design.roles: each identity is malicious in exactly one run of the family and benign (B1) in the other; in every container of 4 identities two are malicious in run A and two in run B, so both labels occur in every run and every container
twin_design.malicious_types: M12 families: 10 M1 + 10 M2 per run (seeded); M3 families: 20 M3 per run
twin_design.b2: not branched (container-level intervention); excluded from the matched experiment
twin_design.invariant_test: tests/test_twin.py and twin_checks.pair_invariants (also run in the data-quality gate)

dry_run.label: MDEV
dry_run.use: mechanics, matching feasibility and the pre-specified sample-size calculation only; never in the final analysis

final_m3.label: MM3
final_m3.generate_after: the matched experiment is fully locked

novelty.reference: benign sessions of Pilot-v2 TRAIN-v2 (10 runs x 32 = 320 sessions)
novelty.N: mean distance to the k nearest reference sessions
novelty.standardization: per feature: mean and sample SD (ddof=1) of the reference set; SD floored (count features sub_novel_count and reconnects_60s: 1.0, others 1e-6)
novelty.primary_rationale: generic magnitude of rate, timing and size change relative to source behaviour. The three structural features (topic_novelty, sub_novel_count, reconnects_60s) are where the generators put the malicious signature; including them in the novelty measure would define the effect away (retention is expected to collapse).
novelty.secondary_features: all 7 features (descriptive: matching on overall distance)
novelty.caliper: c = 1.0 x SD(ln N of the BENIGN twin sessions of the dry-run families); the same rule separately for the secondary novelty
novelty.matching: a twin pair is retained if |ln N(malicious twin) - ln N(benign twin)| <= c
novelty.unmatched_pairs: excluded from PMP; always counted; included in AUC_pooled; reported by malicious type; PMP over all pairs is reported as a secondary number
novelty.min_retention_rule: if the fraction of retained pairs in the final M12 families is below 0.30, the primary result is declared INCONCLUSIVE (retention); the caliper is not changed. The same threshold in the dry run is a go/no-go gate for generating the final data.

primary_analysis.detector: D1 = the frozen calibrated Random Forest of configs/pilot_stage3a_v2.json (RF fitted on TRAIN-v2, isotonic calibration on CAL-v2, unchanged settings and random state)
primary_analysis.metric: PMP = P(s_malicious > s_benign) over retained twin pairs
primary_analysis.ties: a tie counts 1/2 (isotonic calibration produces plateaus)
primary_analysis.estimator: ratio estimator: sum of pair wins / number of retained pairs, pooled over families
primary_analysis.inference: family-clustered percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples of families with replacement, seeded from analysis_seed; one-sided 97.5% bound = 2.5th percentile; sessions and pairs inside a family are never treated as independent
primary_analysis.contrast_conventional: AUC_pooled = Mann-Whitney AUC of D1 over all benign and malicious sessions of the same families (no matching, ties 1/2); Delta_match = AUC_pooled - PMP, a DESCRIPTIVE matched-performance gap with the same bootstrap resamples. No causal interpretation is attached to it.
primary_analysis.P2: lower 97.5% bound of PMP(D1) - PMP(D2) > 0, where D2 is the novelty-only score ln N
primary_analysis.ceiling: RF trained and tested on the twin data with leave-one-family-out cross-validation; PMP on the retained pairs. Diagnostic of identifiability.

decision_rule.SUPPORTED: P1 and P2 hold, retention >= min_retention, and the lower 97.5% bound of the ceiling PMP >= 0.60
decision_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: retention >= min_retention and the upper 97.5% bound of PMP(D1) < 0.55
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: everything else (including low retention or a ceiling below 0.60)

detectors.D3: Isolation Forest fitted on benign TRAIN-v2 sessions (200 trees, contamination auto)
detectors.D4: L2 logistic regression, standardized features, C = 1, fitted on TRAIN-v2

analyses: PMP for D2-D4 with family-clustered intervals
secondary (7-feature) novelty matching with its retention
PMP by structural-signature presence of the malicious twin (any of topic_novelty, sub_novel_count, reconnects_60s non-zero)
held-out M3 families: PMP for all detectors, one-sided test PMP(D1) > 0.5 (secondary, not in the conjunction)

sample_size.rule: computed from the 3 dry-run families before final generation; recorded in the lock file
sample_size.halfwidth_meaning: half-width of the 95% two-sided interval of PMP
sample_size.unit: independent family (the sessions of a family share one environment and are not independent)

exclusion: dry-run families (seed block 3,200,000+) never enter the final analysis; the analysis loader rejects them; Pilot-v1/v2 observations are not final evidence
data_quality_gate: exact run and family counts and seeds
composition and 20/20 labels in every run, 2/2 per container
no seed overlap with any other block
provenance (clean tree, same commit, recomputed hashes)
